tuileriesMemorialReview.modeledLocation: Estimated wall position along the draft route between the French Revolution memorials and the Crypt of the Passion.

sacellumReview.limitations: The Sacellum uses the museum photograph for the stepped altar and the arrangement of the three tablets. Its chamber, wall side and distances are estimated between the Samaritaine and the lamp. Small lettering is unresolved.

martyrsMarkerReview.scope: The close-up includes the Greek and Latin lines, dedication and year. The master adds the French translation, Homer citation and small date lines. The stylized strokes and marker dimensions are interpreted. The photograph does not locate the wall in geographic coordinates.

entryDepthReview.scope: The April 2026 photograph shows the HAUTEUR depth inscription. Its position along the entry gallery and the dimensions of its stone panel are estimated. The historic number is reproduced on the sign. The current floor elevation follows the draft terrain and route controls.

exitShaftPlanCheck.observation: The exit cutaway puts the spiral inside the room to the right of the street passage. The modeled landing ends toward the central passage through a side doorway. The footprint constrains the modeled rim, while its precise center and the room dimensions remain estimated.

easternGalleryReview.interpretation: The 2025 plan depicts the eastern and southern ossuary legs. The English guide routes the visitor toward the Crypt of the Passion via the eastern leg. The model represents the connection as an additional gallery. The 775 m through-route measurement uses the southern branch.
easternGalleryReview.limitation: The museum plan shows an additional east ossuary leg between the northern junction and the Crypt of the Passion approach. Its size, exact bearings and current direction of visitor travel remain estimated.
